headline: CPTPP Members Agree to Establish Support Office in Japan
summary: Members of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership agreed to set up a support office in Japan to manage schedules and documents.
why: Multilateral trade pact administrative setups streamline cooperation and regulatory alignment among member nations.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Hosting a trade agreement office strengthens administrative ties.
